title: AAPS 3.4.1.0 and 3.4.2.1 not sending Treatments to Nightscout
symptom: After updating AAPS from DEV 3.4.0.0 to 3.4.1.0 and 3.4.2.1, treatments are not sent to Nightscout (on Northflank). Device statuses are sent, but the queue number in NSV3 tab increases and only a full sync brings it to 0, after which it rises again. The 'ADD Treatments' option does not appear in the NSClient tab.
cause: The issue is caused by the Medtronic driver, as identified by MilosKozak.
fix: A fix was provided by andyrozman in a branch (issue_4664) that enables refreshes including history reading. The user confirmed that after installing the fix, treatments upload correctly and the queue drops to 0.
